description: Saves a brand, content or content-map document (Markdown or plain text, up to 50,000 characters) under a doc_id such as brand, content or content_map, as a new version; the last 20 versions are kept. Pass base_version (the version you read, 0 when creating) so a concurrent edit is refused instead of overwritten. Nothing is published. Applies after interviewing the user about their brand, summarizing their top posts, or drafting a content map. 繁中：存品牌文件、內容文件或內容地圖，保留最近 20 版。

account_id.description: Optional connected account the document belongs to

content.description: Whole document, Markdown or plain text, up to 50,000 characters

doc_id.description: 1-40 chars of a-z, 0-9, _ or -; suggested: brand, content, content_map

language.description: BCP 47 tag, e.g. zh-TW (default), en, ja

name: save_brand_doc
title: Save a brand document
